gbm_population_evidence.quote: Patients with newly diagnosed, EGFR-amplified, MGMT-unmethylated glioblastoma (as defined by WHO 2021 Classification for CNS Tumors, including that the tumor must be IDH wildtype).

candidate_evidence.quote: [DRUG] CART-EGFR-IL13Ra2 cells: autologous T cells transduced with a bicistronic lentiviral vector containing a murine scFv targeting EGFR epitope 806 and a humanized scFv targeting IL13Ra2

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: in patients with newly diagnosed, EGFR-amplified, MGMT-unmethylated glioblastoma, without evidence of disease recurrence/progression following completion of initial radiotherapy.

role_evidence.quote: [DRUG] CART-EGFR-IL13Ra2 cells: autologous T cells transduced with a bicistronic lentiviral vector containing a murine scFv targeting EGFR epitope 806 and a humanized scFv targeting IL13Ra2

agents.drug_class_hint: autologous bivalent CAR T-cell therapy targeting EGFR epitope 806 and IL13Ra2 (cell therapy)

role_evidence.quote: CART-EGFR-IL13Ra2 cells will be administered via intracerebroventricular delivery in q6 week cycles of treatment, following lymphodepletion with fludarabine, cyclophosphamide, and rituximab.

agents.drug_class_hint: anti-CD20 monoclonal antibody, used here for lymphodepletion before CAR T cells

role_evidence.quote: CART-EGFR-IL13Ra2 cells will be administered via intracerebroventricular delivery in q6 week cycles of treatment, following lymphodepletion with fludarabine, cyclophosphamide, and rituximab.
Fludarabine: 30mg/m2/day x 3 days; Cyclophosphamide: 300mg/m2/day x 3 days

source_quote.quote: Tumor tissue positive for wild-type EGFR amplification by Neogenomics Laboratories
Tumors with an MGMT promoter methylation result of hypermethylated, methylated, low positive methylated, or indeterminate.
Patients with newly diagnosed, EGFR-amplified, MGMT-unmethylated glioblastoma (as defined by WHO 2021 Classification for CNS Tumors, including that the tumor must be IDH wildtype).

coder_notes: Only investigational product is a bivalent CAR T-cell therapy (excluded type), so no candidate. Rituximab, fludarabine and cyclophosphamide are lymphodepleting conditioning for the CAR T cells (R6) -> supportive. EGFR amplification eligibility matches the CAR T target, but the CAR T is not a candidate, so candidate_matched false. MGMT unmethylated required (exclusion of methylated tumours). Radiotherapy is completed before study treatment and not part of experimental arms. Brief summary mentions pharmacokinetics of the CAR T cells (not a candidate).
